scope: target-free exhaustive exact dependency search over all two-key-word half layouts in controlled 6-round ChaCha
active_word_pairs: all 28 unordered pairs from state/key words 4..11
half_model: one logical 8-bit half per active state word; orientation may be swapped after a structural candidate is found but support criterion is symmetric
support_rule: Use exact word-level QR dependency propagation. For active pair {A,B}, PASS only when forward and backward active supports are nonempty, disjoint, and their union is {A,B}.
selection_if_pass: minimum total QR, then lexicographically smaller active pair, then smaller split, then smaller word
stage1_only_if_pass: Freeze fresh numerical outputs for the selected structural candidate and prove each boundary side is a function of only its assigned 8-bit half before TOTAL MITM accounting.
kill_rule: If candidate_count=0, close simple two-word single-boundary dependency-separated MITM for every key-word pair in this reduced six-round structure.
forbidden: No target data, approximate dependency, multi-boundary combination, cancellation assumptions, or post-hoc exclusion of dependency words.
